what: R5 end-to-end scoring rule (PLAN 10.8; r5_train_plan's rule clause and r5_train_plan_amend1's thick-slice clause). Sealed 2026-11-03 before any R5 model exists or is scored, and before any IXI test head was run through navprep.
setting: head-model commit ca8c945: scripts/r5_e2e.py, run by scripts/train_r5_warp.sh after the R5 warp net. Two models, each through scripts/navprep.py --modality mr --cap-gb 7.5 exactly as the locator runs it: 'release' = the live release's models (Dataset601 fold 0, 250 epochs + round 3's warp net with round 4's setting); 'r5' = Dataset602 (nnUNetTrainerHMThick) folds 0-4 ensembled + the R5 warp net (runs/r5/warp/final/last.pt, rule r5_warp_train), round 4's setting. Arms, all made from the case's charm input T1 (scripts/sim_series.py, seed = first 8 hex of sha1('r5-sim:' + case), Rician noise 0.02 of the 99th percentile, 1 mm in plane): 1mm (the T1 itself); ax5 (one axial series, 5 mm slices, no gap); ax5gap (axial, 5 mm, 1 mm gap); axsag5 (axial + sagittal, 5 mm with 1 mm gaps, the sagittal moved U(-2,2) deg and U(-2,2) mm per axis and covering the central 120 mm; navprep's combine stage). Both models see the same input files.
metrics: As M1 (rule m1_mri_e2e), against charm on the ORIGINAL 1 mm T1 of the case: the 10 MNI targets via simnibs.mni2subject_coords (unprojected); the rTMS EEG set (wp3_gate_rtms_set: F3, F4, Fz, Fpz, Fp1, Fp2, Cz, C3, C4, FCz, T7, T8, Oz) and the 4 fiducials warped with our toMNI and projected on OUR skin (the outer skin of our predicted labels, locator_ready.skin_surface) vs charm's eeg_positions; per row the mean of case means and the worst single point over all cases; written-map min Jacobian; navprep wall time and GPU peak.
sets: In this order, each once: (1) pilot = the first 5 sorted R5 warp validation heads, both models, all arms: a machinery check only (these heads were in the training of 4 of the 5 R5 segmenter folds, and the WP3b ones in the release segmenter's): the chain stops before the test set if any run fails or any written map folds; its numbers are reported, never judged. (2) test = the IXI test heads of r5_ixi_split whose charm run finished (data/manifests/r5.json), both models, all arms: the one use of this test set. (3) compare = the 57 WP3 test cases, r5 on the 1mm arm only, against the release's M1 numbers on the same cases (runs/m1_mri_e2e): reported only (these 57 have been scored under 4 earlier rules). r5_e2e.py refuses a test or compare case in either model's segmenter imagesTr or warp train_cases.
rule: R5 replaces the release (adopt) only if ALL hold on the test set's 1mm arm, r5 vs release on the same heads: (1) no folding (below); (2) the sum of r5's three gate-row means (targets, rTMS EEG set on our skin, fiducials on our skin) is lower than the release's; (3) no gate-row mean of r5 is worse than the release's by more than 0.05 mm; (4) no gate-row worst point of r5 is worse than the release's by more than 1.0 mm; (5) r5's navprep wall time <= 120 s per case on average on the RTX 5090; (6) r5's GPU peak <= 7.5 GB. Adopt: a new release (make_release.sh with the R5 models) is built and goes live only with the user's go; the result is reported either way. The WP3 gate (each gate row <= 2 mm mean and <= 5 mm worst point, no folding) is judged and reported per model and arm, and does not change the adoption test. Gate MET for r5's 1mm arm: the MRI fast route may be described as 'agrees with charm within the gate on the held-out IXI test heads (research)'; the provisional label and charm's confirmation stay until the user decides. The thick arms (ax5, ax5gap, axsag5) are reported per arm with their gate rows; they never rescue or block adoption; which input tiers the locator shows as navigable is a later decision of the user, made on these numbers. Reported, not gating: the paired per-case differences on the 1mm arm (mean, Wilcoxon signed-rank p), whole-cap EEG, cases passing all rows. Nothing is re-run on the test set after any code or setting change.
no_folding: written-map min Jacobian > 0 in both MNI2Conform_nonl and Conform2MNI_nonl on every test head of r5's 1mm arm (adoption check (1)); counted and reported for every model and arm.
disclosure: Known before sealing: (1) M1 on the 57 (release models): targets 2.21 / 10.17 mm, rTMS EEG set 3.22 / 14.76, fiducials 3.21 / 14.40; (2) a dry run of this scorer on IXI020-Guys-0700 (an R5 warp training head, so never a test head) with the release models: 1mm targets 2.10 / 3.14, rTMS EEG 2.70 / 4.37, fiducials 1.99 / 3.54; ax5 1.84 / 2.49, 3.01 / 4.59, 1.91 / 4.09; ax5gap 3.09 / 4.35, 3.50 / 6.46, 2.50 / 4.35; axsag5 2.20 / 4.46, 2.95 / 5.05, 1.74 / 2.65; navprep 25-60 s, GPU peak 7.00-7.05 GB; the same run with 1-epoch smoke models gave meaningless R5 numbers and a GPU peak of 7.45 GB on axsag5; (3) no IXI test head has been run through navprep or any warp net.
